passages.title: Elegance and Feasibility
passages.text: The proposal is elegant, admittedly, but elegance is hardly evidence of feasibility. What appears to be a minor concession may, in practice, undermine the very principle the policy was intended to protect.
passages.levelRationale: Rhetorical qualification and precise contrast carry a subtle critique across complex clauses.

passages.title: A Convenient Memory
passages.text: His account was compelling less because it was complete than because its omissions were convenient. By presenting uncertainty as restraint, he transformed a fragile recollection into something that sounded remarkably like settled fact.
passages.levelRationale: Dense rhetorical comparison, implication, and controlled ambiguity demand nuanced delivery.

passages.title: A Carefully Measured Apology
passages.text: The apology was impeccably phrased, which was precisely the problem. Every admission had been measured so carefully that remorse seemed less an emotion than a strategy for ending the conversation.
passages.levelRationale: Irony and an implicit contrast between sincerity and strategy require nuanced rhetorical delivery.

passages.title: The Neutral Algorithm
passages.text: Calling the algorithm neutral does not make its judgments impartial; it merely relocates discretion. The values once debated openly may persist, disguised as technical choices too specialized to question.
passages.levelRationale: Compressed argument, semantic distinction, and implied institutional critique demand precise emphasis.
